title: Sip Account Threshold Rule
description: Represents a sip account threshold rule request

emailAddresses.description: List of email addresses that will be notified when cost threshold is surpassed

phoneNumbers.description: List of phone numbers that will be notified when cost threshold is surpassed

guid.description: Unique identifier for a given threshold rule

voiceAccountGuid.description: The unique identifier of the Voice Account which this SIP Account is part of.

sipAccountGuid.description: The unique identifier of the SIP Account which the rule applies to

threshold.description: Decimal value representing the cost threshold in the currency of the sip account

blockAccountOnThreshold.description: Boolean value whether or not to block the SIP account when the threshold is surpassed

notificationSentOn.description: Last time when a notification has been sent due to the threshold being passed. Null if threshold has never been passed
